info.synopsis: Cuore rubato da una donna dallo spirito libero dopo una storia d'amore sulla spiaggia, un appassionato architetto decide di ricongiungersi con lei per le strade di Seoul.

episodes.name: Lovestruck in the City
episodes.plot: Park Jae-won's first day of vacation starts with a spontaneous singalong in a sunlit van and ends with fireworks — and Yoon Seon-a by his side.

translations.value: Lovestruck in the City
Park Jae-won's first day of vacation starts with a spontaneous singalong in a sunlit van and ends with fireworks — and Yoon Seon-a by his side.

episodes.name: How Do You Initiate Your First Sex?
episodes.plot: Jae-won teaches Seon-a how to surf. The two give in to their feelings, but Jae-won feels betrayed when he wakes up to find Seon-a with someone else.

translations.value: How Do You Initiate Your First Sex?
Jae-won teaches Seon-a how to surf. The two give in to their feelings, but Jae-won feels betrayed when he wakes up to find Seon-a with someone else.

episodes.name: She Drove Me Crazy!
episodes.plot: Seon-a lets misunderstandings cause a rift between her and Jae-won. Wanting to know how she feels, Jae-won asks Seon-a to meet him by a certain hour.

translations.value: She Drove Me Crazy!
Seon-a lets misunderstandings cause a rift between her and Jae-won. Wanting to know how she feels, Jae-won asks Seon-a to meet him by a certain hour.

episodes.name: What Did She Do with the Ring?
episodes.plot: Seon-a and Jae-won's whirlwind romance abruptly ends when he rushes to Seoul for a work emergency. She never calls, but he still wears his ring.

translations.value: What Did She Do with the Ring?
Seon-a and Jae-won's whirlwind romance abruptly ends when he rushes to Seoul for a work emergency. She never calls, but he still wears his ring.

episodes.name: What Do You Do With the Memory Box After Breaking Up?
episodes.plot: With film developed from Jae-won's cameras, Lee Eun-o fondly looks back at their memories. The photographer recognizes the man in the photo.

translations.value: What Do You Do With the Memory Box After Breaking Up?
With film developed from Jae-won's cameras, Lee Eun-o fondly looks back at their memories. The photographer recognizes the man in the photo.

episodes.name: Somebody Stole My Camera!
episodes.plot: Choi Kyeong-jun and Suh Rin-i share their friends-to-lovers story. Almost running into Jae-won, Eun-o reveals the second reason behind their breakup.

translations.value: Somebody Stole My Camera!
Choi Kyeong-jun and Suh Rin-i share their friends-to-lovers story. Almost running into Jae-won, Eun-o reveals the second reason behind their breakup.

episodes.name: I'll Forget It! I'll Throw It Away!
episodes.plot: Jae-won drunkenly visits the police station to file another report on Seon-a, the thief who stole his cameras and his heart.

translations.value: I'll Forget It! I'll Throw It Away!
Jae-won drunkenly visits the police station to file another report on Seon-a, the thief who stole his cameras and his heart.

episodes.name: Love Is Supposed to Be Crazy
episodes.plot: Desperate to get over Seon-a, Jae-won seeks help and talks about the time she appeared in his dream. He catches her off guard at their meeting place.

translations.value: Love Is Supposed to Be Crazy
Desperate to get over Seon-a, Jae-won seeks help and talks about the time she appeared in his dream. He catches her off guard at their meeting place.

episodes.name: What if You Run Into Your Ex?
episodes.plot: At the police station, Jae-won discovers the truth and a world of hurt after reuniting with Seon-a, who reluctantly reveals her real name.

translations.value: What if You Run Into Your Ex?
At the police station, Jae-won discovers the truth and a world of hurt after reuniting with Seon-a, who reluctantly reveals her real name.

episodes.name: Lee Eun-o? Lee Eun-o!
episodes.plot: Eun-o's emotional fallout puzzles Kang Geon. Rin-i unleashes her fury on a man responsible for her friend's heartbreak and disappearance.

translations.value: Lee Eun-o? Lee Eun-o!
Eun-o's emotional fallout puzzles Kang Geon. Rin-i unleashes her fury on a man responsible for her friend's heartbreak and disappearance.

episodes.name: Is There Such a Thing as a Proper Break-Up?
episodes.plot: Kyeong-jun tells a curious Jae-won details about Eun-o’s life, then invites him to a gathering at her home later that night.

translations.value: Is There Such a Thing as a Proper Break-Up?
Kyeong-jun tells a curious Jae-won details about Eun-o’s life, then invites him to a gathering at her home later that night.

episodes.name: That's How I Became Yoon Seon-a
episodes.plot: In the past, romantic betrayal and professional setbacks led Eun-o to try out life as Seon-a and meet Jae-won. She regrets it all now.

translations.value: That's How I Became Yoon Seon-a
In the past, romantic betrayal and professional setbacks led Eun-o to try out life as Seon-a and meet Jae-won. She regrets it all now.

episodes.name: Have You Ever Blacked Out?
episodes.plot: Eun-o wakes up in Jae-won's home the morning after a boozy night. Once again, they find themselves together in a car on a rainy day.

translations.value: Have You Ever Blacked Out?
Eun-o wakes up in Jae-won's home the morning after a boozy night. Once again, they find themselves together in a car on a rainy day.

episodes.name: What Kind of Woman is She?
episodes.plot: Kyeong-jun floats the idea of Rin-i pursuing a career instead of more part-time jobs. Eun-o's hidden feelings for Jae-won are unexpectedly revealed.

translations.value: What Kind of Woman is She?
Kyeong-jun floats the idea of Rin-i pursuing a career instead of more part-time jobs. Eun-o's hidden feelings for Jae-won are unexpectedly revealed.

episodes.name: It's So Hard to Get Honest
episodes.plot: Earnest conversations bring closure to former couples. Eun-o comes clean about both her secret life as Seon-a and relationship with Jae-won.

translations.value: It's So Hard to Get Honest
Earnest conversations bring closure to former couples. Eun-o comes clean about both her secret life as Seon-a and relationship with Jae-won.

episodes.name: What Do You Think Love Is?
episodes.plot: Rin-i is dismayed by Kyeong-jun's honest opinion of her lifestyle. Telling him about all her flaws and fears, Eun-o asks Jae-won if he can accept her.

translations.value: What Do You Think Love Is?
Rin-i is dismayed by Kyeong-jun's honest opinion of her lifestyle. Telling him about all her flaws and fears, Eun-o asks Jae-won if he can accept her.

episodes.name: Winter, Midnight, Seoul
episodes.plot: Eun-o helps an actress escape from set. Oh Dong-sik's birthday is nothing short of spectacular, complete with a foot chase and a sweet surprise.

translations.title: Lovestruck in the City
translations.overview: Cuore rubato da una donna dallo spirito libero dopo una storia d'amore sulla spiaggia, un appassionato architetto decide di ricongiungersi con lei per le strade di Seoul.

translations.title: Lovestruck in the City
translations.overview: Heart stolen by a free-spirited woman after a beachside romance, a passionate architect sets out to reunite with her on the streets of Seoul.

translations.title: 도시남녀의 사랑법
translations.overview: 1년 전 여름, 건축가 박재원은 한 달간의 휴가를 보내러 간 강원도 양양에서 자유분방한 매력을 지닌 윤선아를 만나 뜨거운 사랑에 빠진다. 그러나 서울에서 다시 만나자던 약속을 남긴 채 그녀는 이별 통보와 함께 재원의 카메라를 훔쳐 홀연히 사라진다. 그녀를 잊지 못해 서울 곳곳을 헤매던 재원은 마침내 그녀와 다시 마주치지만, 그녀의 진짜 이름은 윤선아가 아닌 이은오였다. 은오가 다른 사람의 이름으로 살아야 했던 사연은 무엇일까. 여기에 재원의 사촌동생 경준과 그의 연인 린이, 은오의 소꿉친구 건과 그의 옛 연인 선영까지, 복잡한 도시 속 여섯 남녀가 저마다의 방식으로 사랑하고 헤어진다.
translations.tagline: 내가 사랑한 그녀는 존재하지 않는 사람이었다
